Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Join activities on activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.pchembl_value is not null and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'
Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id
Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1275221'
Join compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno
Filter target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value
Sort by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
Limit 1000
